definition.en: The World Trade Organization is the only global international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations.
definition.hi: The World Trade Organization is the only global international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations.

importanceInUpsc.en: The WTO is a critical component of the GS-3 syllabus under the Indian Economy section, as it dictates the framework for India's international trade policies. Understanding its mechanisms is essential for analyzing India's stance in multilateral negotiations and its impact on domestic sectors like agriculture and services.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the institutional structure and core principles of the WTO.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of WTO agreements on the Indian economy and policy-making.
